page.overview:
Who is Splinter (robot)?

Along with robots masquerading as prominent world leaders, the developed a fake as part of their line of androids, in order to deceive and defeat the . It was unsuccessful in beating them and wound up destroyed.

A reconstructed or second Foot Mech Splinter appeared later as a competitor in Foot Fight tournament along with other Foot Clan members.
